We combine mechanistic cancer biology with neuroscience, immunology, advanced in vivo models, spatial and single-cell technologies, functional imaging and translational human studies.Our ambition is clear: to define and lead emerging concepts in cancer neuroscience rather than merely follow them.The laboratory operates in a highly competitive and well-funded environment with support from, among others, the European Research Council (ERC), Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG), Deutsche Krebshilfe and Else Kröner-Fresenius-Stiftung, and is embedded in a strong national and international network in cancer neuroscience.Your responsibilities:The successful candidate will take a central scientific role in our experimental program and will contribute to the conception, execution and development of ambitious projects addressing neural–tumor–immune interactions.Depending on expertise, projects may include:- mechanistic studies of neuron–cancer and neuro–immune interactions- functional characterization of neural signaling pathways in cancer- genetically engineered and orthotopic in vivo tumor models- manipulation of neuronal, immune and tumor-cell populations- advanced imaging and molecular phenotyping- integration of molecular, cellular and spatial data with functional experiments- development of new experimental concepts and therapeutic strategies in cancer neuroscienceA particularly important aspect of the position is the strategic management and further development of our animal experimentation platform.This may include:- preparation and coordination of animal study applications and amendments- planning and supervision of complex in vivo experiments- establishment and optimization of experimental mouse models- management of genetically modified mouse colonies- breeding strategy, genotyping and colony planning- coordination with animal facilities, authorities and collaborating laboratories- implementation of high standards in experimental design, documentation and animal welfareYour profile:We are looking for a scientist with a strong experimental background in at least one – preferably several – of the following fields: Cancer Biology | Tumor Immunology | Neuroscience | Neuroimmunology | Molecular BiologyYou should have:- a PhD or equivalent doctoral degree in a relevant life-science discipline- substantial hands-on experience in experimental biomedical research as well as experience with in vivo models, ideally tumor models and/or neuroscience models- strong expertise in molecular and cellular biology and the ability to independently design, troubleshoot and drive complex experiments- excellent scientific communication skills in English- a highly collaborative but intellectually independent working styleParticularly desirable is extensive experience with:- animal experimentation and experimental planning and preparation or management of animal experimentation applications- genetically engineered mouse models as well as mouse breeding and colony management- tumor models and neuroscience or neuroimmunology techniquesWe offer you:- This is not intended to be a purely technical postdoctoral position.- We offer the opportunity to become a scientifically visible and intellectually independent member of a rapidly developing research program, with substantial room to shape projects and develop an individual research profile. - Our goal is to attract scientists who want to build a field, not simply complete a project.- You will work in an internationally competitive cancer neuroscience environment; ERC-, DFG-, Deutsche Krebshilfe- and foundation-funded research programs; highly interdisciplinary collaborations spanning cancer biology, neuroscience, immunology, surgery, pathology, spatial biology and computational biology- We offe you projects with strong potential for high-impact publications and a translational environment with direct access to human cancer material and clinically relevant questions as well as an international network of leading scientists in the emerging field of Cancer Neuroscience- EGYM well pass, corporate benefits and discounts (e.g. Käfer), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers- Working in the heart of Munich at Max-Weber-Platz with very good accessibility by public transport such as the subway, S-Bahn or tram We look forward to meeting you!Contact: Sarah A background in radiation biology and radiation-induced normal-tissue effects would be advantageous - The ability to independently plan, conduct, analyze, and document experimental studies is expected - A strong interest in interdisciplinary and translational research at the interface of radiation oncology, medical physics, and biology is essential - Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in an interdisciplinary research environment are required - jobs.description: FACILITIES MANAGER EUROPE (F/M/D)At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, we develop regulated technology that helps unlock better evidence and improve patient outcomes worldwide. Clario's primary European facilities are situated in Germany, Hungary, Belgium, Switzerland, and Turkey.*Facility Layout Standards and Compliance: Supporting facility layout standards for electrical systems, HVAC, IT infrastructure (phones, conference systems, displays), materials, access control and more. Collaborating with local contractors/vendors/departments to manage these processes through to completion, ensuring compliance with local and state building codes.*Site Coordination: Managing and coordinating the logistics involved in opening, relocating, or closing a facility, including security systems, access control, furniture, signage, showroom/marketing requirements, telecommunications, and more.*Budgeting and Capital Expenditure: Actively participating in the capital expenditure budgeting process and managing purchasing requests for facility needs. Accurately forecasting and preparing facility-related budgets. Conducting financial and business analysis, including preparing reports on expenditures, savings, and areas for cost optimization.*Compliance and Standards Development: Ensuring all facilities are operated and maintained in compliance with local, state, and national laws, company standards, and procedures. Responsible for developing and refining standards as business needs evolve, including ensuring annual occupational safety and fire inspections where applicable.*Stakeholder and Management Communication: Maintaining a dotted line to the local management teams, participating in and reporting at management meetings. Building strong relationships with key business stakeholders by collecting feedback and delivering reports on business-critical aspects, such as occupancy, site launches, and facility improvements and audits.*External Relations and First Point of Contact: Serving as the First Point of Contact for the landlord, labor inspectorate, municipalities, authorities, and occupational safety departments.*Vendor and Contractor Management: Building and maintaining strong relationships with local building management and managing third-party contractors/vendors responsible for facility maintenance and operations. This includes monitoring tasks completed, overseeing technical acceptance, and approving invoices.*Lease and Contract Management: Managing leases and facility agreements, including understanding legal terms and commercial contract structures. Ensuring contracts are renewed and negotiated in a timely manner.*Sustainability and Energy Efficiency: Supporting sustainability initiatives by tracking, reporting, and working towards reducing emissions and waste across facility operations. Implementing energy-saving initiatives, including tracking energy consumption and suggesting areas for improvement.*Crisis and Emergency Management: Developing and maintaining emergency response plans for the facility, including fire drills, evacuation procedures, and pandemic-related safety measures.*Training and Development: Coordinating safety and facility-related training for employees to ensure everyone is aware of evacuation procedures, safety protocols, and proper usage of shared resources like conference rooms, equipment, and storage areas.*Team Collaboration and Support: Contributing to team success by assisting colleagues in resolving internal issues and supporting shared goals.*Quality and Standards Management: Ensuring adherence to organizational SOPs by regularly reviewing and understanding operational guidelines. Supporting the establishment and enforcement of departmental standards to maintain consistent quality service.*Technical and Industry Development: Enhancing expertise through active participation in company-sponsored training programs and maintaining up-to-date knowledge of industry trends and emerging technologies to drive innovation and informed decision-making.WHAT WE LOOK FOR*Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management or a comparable degree with a technical background, alongside additional business management training or further development.*Five or more years of experience in facilities management or an equivalent role, including proven experience in managing technical building projects.*Fluent language skills in both German and English are required. Additional language skills are beneficial.*Organizational and time management skills to prioritize tasks and meet established schedules, timelines, or deadlines.*Creative problem-solving skills with strong project management abilities.*Proficiency in working with computer software, including the MS Office suite.*Ability to influence others without direct authority.*Strong ability to adapt to changing priorities.*A strong desire to succeed while maintaining a professional and positive attitude.*Flexibility to travel to our European sites as needed, typically averaging two trips per year.At Clario, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day.
